plan_findings_status.title: Composer profile drift surfaces as 'le choix #N n'appartient pas au profil publié'
plan_findings_status.notes: Throw site is assertComposerSelectionsBelongToPublishedProfile (lines 659-699), invoked from line 603 inside validateRequestItems. Sub-cause analysis sound. Listener InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange IS wired (EventServiceProvider line 223). Server cache evicted but SPA in-memory cache NOT. Plan cites ComposerProfileService.php:142,149 — actual lines are 142 (updated), 169 (published), 245 (unpublished). Minor cite error.

plan_findings_status.title: FR-lock invariant (ADR-007) not enforced server-side
plan_findings_status.notes: Middleware validates against Branch.activeLocales() only. config('kiosk.locale_switch_allowed') is exposed but never read for enforcement. A hostile client can send X-Kiosk-Locale: en on a branch with multi-locale enabled even when V1 FR-lock should block. T-B3 plan is correct fix.

plan_findings_status.title: FrontendOrderService kiosk machine resolution silent-pick
plan_findings_status.notes: where('user_id', Auth::id())->first() without ordering. Under BranchScope, admin (branch_id=0) sees all branches; staff sees only its own. T-B4 fix sound. Alternative: deterministic orderBy(branch_id) or DB UNIQUE(user_id, branch_id) constraint.

plan_findings_status.title: OrderQuoteService kiosk lookup BranchScope asymmetry vs login path
plan_findings_status.notes: Login path uses withoutGlobalScope(BranchScope::class). Quote path does not. Mismatched intent. T-B5 one-line fix.

plan_findings_status.title: PosController::quote kiosk-surface ability gate is session-guard-permissive
plan_findings_status.notes: On api/frontend/*, permission:pos is bypassed. OrderQuoteService::resolveBranchId tokenCan check is gated by `$token !== null`. Session/guard-auth users with TransientToken pass through. T-B6 sentinel essential. Also need to assert TransientToken bypass closed.

plan_findings_status.notes: Expected per BRAIN §2 (iter1-14 + Wave Z accumulation). Baseline = HEAD@phase0 snapshot. T-B8 sentinel design pattern correct.

plan_findings_status.title: Composer profile cache fanout to kiosk SPA missing
plan_findings_status.notes: Server cache invalidated. SPA in-memory store (kioskMenu.js) not notified — refetches lazily. T-B9 Pusher broadcast pattern aligns with Wave 5G SettingsUpdated fanout.

plan_findings_status.title: Wizard a11y focus order on touch screen
plan_findings_status.notes: Frozen-zone-test-allowed pattern. Vitest spec per T-B11.

plan_findings_status.title: KioskLocale observability noise

plan_findings_status.title: KioskMachineLoginController logout sweep under BranchScope
plan_findings_status.notes: KioskMachine::where('user_id', $user->id)->get() under BranchScope. Inconsistent with login path which uses withoutGlobalScope. One-line fix in T-B12 cluster.

plan_findings_status.title: Kiosk SPA token storage in localStorage (XSS surface)
plan_findings_status.notes: state.kioskToken persisted via vuex-persistedstate (localStorage). Mitigations rely on CSP script-src restrictions — verify via T-B12 spec.

plan_findings_status.title: KioskEvent throttle 30/min may be tight
plan_findings_status.notes: 30/min for telemetry. Wave Z noted possible drops. T-B12 measurement-driven approach correct.

new_findings.title: Kiosk machine credentials exposed unauthenticated on /kiosk/* URLs via master.blade.php inline JS
new_findings.mechanism: routes/web.php:62 catch-all Route::get('/{any}', RootController::index)->middleware(['installed']) matches /kiosk/* with no auth gate. Blade line 113 injects 'kioskAutoLogin: @json(request()->is("kiosk*") ? config("kiosk.spa_payload") : null)'. config('kiosk.spa_payload') returns {username, password} cleartext from env. APP_ENV=local hardcodes kiosk-lecayenne/kiosk123.
new_findings.exploit_path: curl https://host/kiosk/idle → HTML contains window.foodkingConfig.kioskAutoLogin = {username, password} → use vs /api/auth/kiosk-login → mint kiosk:order Sanctum token → place orders / scrape data.
mitigation_options: Option A: Server-side runtime guard (IP allowlist, local network only) wrapped around the @json conditional
Option B: Client-certificate (mTLS) gate so credentials never in HTML
Option C: Remove KIOSK_MACHINE_USERNAME/PASSWORD env; require manual machine login first boot
new_findings.sentinel_test: tests/Feature/Kiosk/KioskAutoLoginPayloadUnauthenticatedAccessTest.php — GET /kiosk/idle no-auth → assert no plaintext password in response body

new_findings.title: MenuController::kiosk cache key not scoped by locale
new_findings.notes: $cacheKey = "kiosk.menu.branch.{$branchId}" — locale not in key. If KioskMenuService::build returns locale-dependent strings, first cacher wins for 60s default TTL. UX bug, not security.
new_findings.mitigation: Suffix cache key with resolved locale; or document why KioskMenuService::build is locale-invariant.

new_findings.title: PricingPreviewController lacks defense-in-depth tokenCan check at controller layer
new_findings.notes: Controller relies on PricingPreviewRequest::authorize() which returns user->tokenCan('kiosk:order'). TransientToken returns true for any ability, so session-guard admin could reach the handler — gated only by absence of KioskMachine row (503).
